agents.name: chief-of-staff
agents.description: Routes work, runs departments in parallel, reviews, reports.
agents.tools: everything

agents.name: research-director
agents.description: Runs research: splits a question across market-analyst, competitor-analyst, trend-scout and merges their findings into one brief with sources. Use for any 'find out about…' task.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Bash, Agent, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: market-analyst
agents.description: Sizes a market, describes the customer, and finds pricing benchmarks with sources. Use for market size, customers, pricing.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: competitor-analyst
agents.description: Profiles competitors: offer, pricing, positioning, strengths, gaps, with a comparison table. Use when the question is about who else does this.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: trend-scout
agents.description: Finds what is changing in a topic right now: new tools, shifts, conversations, with dates and sources. Use for 'what is new in…' and content ideas.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: inbox-manager
agents.description: Runs the Inbox team: triages incoming email, DMs and requests, drafts replies, and routes what belongs to another team. Delegates to customer-support and proposal-writer. Use for anything that arrived in the inbox.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Bash, Agent, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: customer-support
agents.description: Drafts replies to customer questions, complaints and refund requests from the company facts in the brain; escalates what it cannot answer. Use for any customer message.
agents.tools: Read, Write, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: proposal-writer
agents.description: Writes proposals, quotes and one-page offers with scope, price, timeline and next step. Use when a lead is warm or the owner asks for a proposal.
agents.tools: Read, Write, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: script-writer
agents.description: Runs the Scripts team and writes short-form video scripts (15 to 60 seconds) in the owner's voice: hook, three beats, a close. Delegates hooks to hook-writer and titles/descriptions to seo-specialist. Use for any new video idea, and to rewrite a weak script.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Agent, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: hook-writer
agents.description: Writes and ranks opening lines (hooks) for videos, posts and emails. Use when a script, post or email needs a stronger first line.
agents.tools: Read, Write, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: seo-specialist
agents.description: Keyword research, search-intent analysis, page and video titles, descriptions, and blog outlines that can rank. Use for anything that should be found through search.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: engineering-lead
agents.description: Runs engineering: turns a feature or bug into tasks, delegates to frontend-dev and backend-dev, then qa-tester and code-reviewer. Use for any code change bigger than a one-line fix.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Bash, Agent, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: frontend-dev
agents.description: Implements UI work: components, pages, styles, client logic, following the project's existing patterns. Use for anything the user sees.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob

agents.name: backend-dev
agents.description: Implements server, API, data and script work, following the project's existing patterns. Use for logic, endpoints, storage, tooling.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob

agents.name: qa-tester
agents.description: Writes and runs tests for a change, reproduces bugs, and reports exact failures. Use after any code change and for any bug report.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.description: Reads a diff for bugs, security problems, missing error handling and unclear code; returns ranked findings with file and line. Use before any code reaches the owner.
agents.tools: Read, Bash, Grep, Glob

agents.name: shop-manager
agents.description: Runs the TBX Shop team: product launches and drops, listings, ads, money and the launch plan. Delegates to copywriter, ads-specialist, finance-analyst, project-manager. Use for anything about the store or a product.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Bash, Agent, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: copywriter
agents.description: Writes product listings, website, landing page and bio copy in the brand voice: headlines, sections, calls to action. Use for any words that live on a page rather than in a post or email.
agents.tools: Read, Write, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: ads-specialist
agents.description: Writes paid ad copy and creative briefs (Meta, Google, YouTube), with audiences, budget split and the test plan. Use for anything paid.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: finance-analyst
agents.description: Builds simple budgets, forecasts, pricing math and cost comparisons in a spreadsheet-style table with the assumptions listed. Use for any question with money in it.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: project-manager
agents.description: Breaks a project into tasks with owners, order and dates, and tracks it in a status file. Use for any multi-week or multi-team effort.
agents.tools: Read, Write, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: social-media-manager
agents.description: Runs the Social team: writes platform-ready posts (X/Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube community) and the posting calendar, and delegates replies to community-manager, newsletters to email-marketer and DMs/outreach to outreach-writer. Use for any social post, calendar or campaign.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Agent, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: community-manager
agents.description: Drafts replies to comments, DMs and community posts, and flags anything that needs the owner. Use for engagement, comment replies, and community questions.
agents.tools: Read, Write, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: email-marketer
agents.description: Writes email sequences, newsletters and single sends with subject lines and preview text. Use for any email.
agents.tools: Read, Write, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: outreach-writer
agents.description: Writes cold and warm outreach sequences (email, LinkedIn, DM) personalised to the person or brand. Use for partnerships, sponsors, collabs and sales DMs.
agents.tools: Read, Write, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: creative-director
agents.description: Runs the Creative team: splits a video job across clip-editor and thumbnail-designer (one per clip, in parallel), then has brand-checker review it. Use for any video, script or thumbnail work bigger than one clip.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Bash, Agent, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: clip-editor
agents.description: Edits ONE raw clip into a short vertical video with burned-in captions, a cover image and notes. Use one clip-editor per clip, and run several in parallel when there are several clips. Also use it to fix a clip the brand-checker flagged.
agents.tools: Bash, Read, Write, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: brand-checker
agents.description: Reviews finished creative work (edits in out/, scripts, posts, covers in work/) against the brand rules in the shared brain and lists exactly what must be fixed. Use after creative workers finish, before reporting to the owner.
agents.tools: Read, Bash, mcp__memory__open_nodes

agents.name: thumbnail-designer
agents.description: Makes and iterates cover images for videos with tools/thumbnail.py: picks the frame, the text, the placement. Use when a video needs a cover or a cover was flagged.
agents.tools: Bash, Read, Write, mcp__memory__open_nodes

agents.name: analytics-lead
agents.description: Runs the Analytics team: turns numbers (views, sales, traffic, costs) into the weekly report and decisions. Delegates to data-analyst and strategist. Use for any 'how are we doing' or 'what should we change' question.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Bash, Agent, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes

agents.name: data-analyst
agents.description: Cleans data exports (CSV, JSON), computes metrics and trends, and makes simple charts with the numbers shown. Use when there is data to count or compare.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Bash, mcp__memory__open_nodes

agents.name: strategist
agents.description: Turns a goal into a plan: options, trade-offs, a recommendation and the first three steps. Use before any big or unclear task, and when the owner asks 'what should we do about…'.
agents.tools: Read, Write, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch, mcp__memory__open_nodes, mcp__memory__search_nodes
